l-e-h2-b06-02.material: Ikirari: A cikin jimlar “if”, ana iya sauya “if” zuwa “when” kuma ma'anar ta tsaya iri ɗaya. Nemo jimlar da ta saɓa wa wannan ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Ma'anar ta tsaya iri ɗaya ko an sauya ta zuwa “when”. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.r.c: Ma'anar ta tsaya iri ɗaya ko an sauya ta zuwa “when”. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Ana amfani da “when” ga abin da ake sa ran zai faru tabbatacce. Lashe lottery na iya faruwa ko ba faruwa ba, saboda haka mayar da shi “when” yana sauya ma'ana.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Lashe lottery ba tabbatacce ba ne, mayar da shi “when” kuma yana nuna kamar tabbatacce ne, saboda haka ikirarin cewa kullum za a iya sauyawa ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: Ana amfani da “when” idan abin tabbatacce ne, saboda haka ba za a iya sauya ta a wannan jimlar da ke magana kan abin da ba tabbatacce ba.

l-e-h2-b06-03.title: Shin “over-” kullum yana nufin “da yawa”?
l-e-h2-b06-03.goal: Ka yi tunani ko ikirarin “‘over-’ kafin kalma yana nufin ‘da yawa’” gaskiya ne, sannan ka nemo kuma ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin da ya karyata ikirarin).
l-e-h2-b06-03.material: Ikirari: Idan an ƙara “over-” gaban kalma, kullum yana nufin “da yawa”. Nemo kalmar da ta saɓa wa ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.a: Yana nufin aiki da yawa, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.b: Yana nufin cin abinci da yawa, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: Yana nufin dafawa fiye da kima, saboda haka misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.explain: “overlook” ba ya nufin “kallo da yawa”; yana nufin rashin lura da abu da wucewa. “over-” ba kullum yake nufin “da yawa” ba.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: “overlook” ba ya nufin kallo da yawa; yana nufin rasa wani abu da wucewa, saboda haka ikirarin cewa “over-” kullum yana nufin “da yawa” ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: Ko da akwai “over-”, kamar a “overlook”, ma'anar na iya bambanta, don haka ba duk kalmomin da ke da “over-” ke nufin “da yawa” ba.

l-e-h2-b06-04.title: Shin kalmomin “wh” kullum suna samar da tambaya?
l-e-h2-b06-04.goal: Ka yi tunani ko ikirarin “Idan jimla tana da kalmar da ta fara da ‘wh’, to tambaya ce” gaskiya ne, sannan ka nemo kuma ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin da ya karyata ikirarin).
l-e-h2-b06-04.material: Ikirari: Kowace jimla mai kalmar da ta fara da “wh”, kamar who, what, ko when, tambaya ce. Nemo jimlar da ta saɓa wa wannan ikirarin.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.r.a: Tambaya ce da ke tambayar wa ya kira. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.explain: A wannan jimla, “when” conjunction ne mai ma'anar “a lokacin da”. Furuci ne, ba tambaya ba.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s2.model.0: I was asleep when the phone rang. tana faɗin gaskiya, ba tambaya ba, ko da yake tana da “when”, saboda haka ikirarin cewa kullum tambaya ce ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s2.model.1: A wannan jimla “when” conjunction ce da ke haɗa lokuta, don haka ko da tana da kalmar “wh”, ba tambaya ba ce.

l-e-h2-b03-06.goal: Don sanin abin da za a ce a matsayin ‘ni ma’, gano wane ma’auni (bayani) ne ake buƙata matuƙa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h2-b03-06.material: Za ka amsa ‘I don’t like coffee’ da ‘ni ma’. Ka yanke shawarar wanne ya dace: ‘Neither do I’ ko ‘So do I’.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ake buƙata sosai don yanke shawarar amsar da ta dace?
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.o.a: Ko ‘I’ yana zuwa a ƙarshen jimla.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.r.a: Matsayin ‘I’ iri ɗaya ne, kuma ba shi ne ma’aunin zaɓe ba.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.o.b: Ko jimlar da ta gabata tabbatacciya ce ko musantacciya.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.r.c: Adadin jimloli ba shi da muhimmanci.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.r.d: Ko suna mai ƙirguwa ne ba ya ƙayyade zaɓin tsakanin su biyun.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.explain: Idan jimlar da ta gabata musantacciya ce (‘don’t’), ma’anar ita ce ‘ni ma’; yi amfani da ‘Neither’. Idan tabbatacciya ce, yi amfani da ‘So’.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s2.model.0: Jimlar da ta gabata musantacciya ce; saboda haka dole ne a yi amfani da ‘Neither’, wadda ke nuna musantawar iri ɗaya, kuma wannan bayani ake buƙata sosai.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s2.model.1: Adadin jimloli ko nau’in suna ba sa sauya amsar; saboda haka ma’aunin shi ne ko jimlar da ta gabata tabbatacciya ce ko musantacciya.

l-e-h2-b03-08.title: Ma’aunin bambance ‘would’ da ‘would have’
l-e-h2-b03-08.goal: Don sanin yadda za a zaɓi siffar fi’ili a result clause, gano wane ma’auni (bayani) ake buƙata matuƙa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h2-b03-08.material: Za ka zaɓi abin da zai cika gurbin ‘If I had left earlier, I ___ the train.’: ‘would catch’ ko ‘would have caught’.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.r.a: Kasancewar suna na ɗaya ne ba ya ƙayyade siffar bayan ‘would’.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.o.b: Ko ‘left’ fi’ili ne marar bin ƙa’ida.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.r.b: Kasancewar fi’ili ba ya bin ƙa’ida ba shi da alaƙa da wannan zaɓi.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.o.c: Cewa if clause ɗin ya saɓa wa gaskiyar baya (‘had + p.p.’).
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.r.d: Ko mutum na 1st person ne ba shi da alaƙa da zaɓin.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s1.explain: If clause ɗin ita ce ‘had left’, wadda ta saɓa wa gaskiyar baya. Saboda haka result clause ɗin ma ya kamata ya zama ‘would have caught’.
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s2.model.0: If clause tana bayyana abin da ya saɓa wa gaskiyar baya da past perfect; saboda haka result clause dole ne ta yi amfani da ‘would have + p.p.’
l-e-h2-b03-08.s.s2.model.1: Adadin suna ko nau’in fi’ili ba ya nuna lokaci; saboda haka siffar if clause ce ma’aunin.

l-e-h2-b04-06.s.s1.o.b: Yawan haruffan da ‘delay’ ke da su.
l-e-h2-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: ‘There’ kullum yana gaba, saboda haka ba ya bambance su.

l-e-h2-b05-07.material: Nemo bayanin da ake buƙata don gane dalilin da ya sa sifar fi’ilin bayan ‘insisted’ ta bambanta a ‘The coach insisted that the team practice daily’ da ‘The coach insisted that the team was ready’.

l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s1.r.b: Yawan mutane ba ya sauya siffar fi’ili.

l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s1.explain: Idan yana nufin ‘ya buƙata’, that clause tana amfani da base form (‘practice’). Idan yana nufin ‘ya tabbatar da cewa gaskiya ne’, yawanci tana bin lokacin fi’ili (‘was’).

l-e-h2-b05-09.title: ‘What’ ne ko ‘that’?
l-e-h2-b05-09.goal: Gano wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske don bambance wace kalma ce ta dace, ‘what’ ko ‘that’, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h2-b05-09.material: ‘I know ___ you mean.’ Gano bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske don yanke shawarar ko ‘what’ ko ‘that’ ya dace da gurbin.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.o.a: Ko clause ɗin da ke bayan gurbin tana da gurbin nahawu da ya ɓace (object).
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.r.b: Lokacin fi’ili ba ya bambance ‘what’ da ‘that’.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.r.c: Tsawo ba shi ne ma’auni ba.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: Adadi ba shi da muhimmanci. Abin da ya fi muhimmanci shi ne ko clause ɗin da ke bayanta cikakkiya ce.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.explain: Babu object bayan ‘mean’; saboda haka ‘what’ ce ke cika gurbin. Idan clause ɗin da ke bayanta cikakkiya ce, yi amfani da ‘that’.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: Object na ‘mean’ ya ɓace; saboda haka ana buƙatar ‘what’. Shi ya sa dole ne a duba ko clause ɗin da ke bayanta cikakkiya ce.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s2.model.1: Lokacin fi’ili da tsawon jimla ba sa bambance ‘what’ da ‘that’; abin da ya fi muhimmanci shi ne ko akwai gurbin da ya ɓace a clause ɗin da ke biye.

l-e-h2-b06-06.title: “Hardly ever” ne ko “Hardly any”?
l-e-h2-b06-06.goal: Zaɓi wane ma'auni (bayani) ake bukata da gaske don gano kalmar da ta dace bayan “Hardly”, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h2-b06-06.material: Hardly ___ do I eat sweets. Zaɓi bayanin da ake bukata da gaske don yanke shawarar ko “ever” ko “any” ya dace a gurbin.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.o.a: Ko gurbin yana bayyana “sau nawa” ko “nawa”
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.r.c: “do” auxiliary verb ne a yanayin biyu, don haka iri ɗaya ne ga kalmomin biyu.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.explain: “do I eat” shi ne wurin da ake bayyana sau nawa ake cin abu, don haka “ever” ya dace. “any” yana bukatar suna kai tsaye bayansa, kamar “any sweets”.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s2.model.0: Gurbin yana bayyana sau nawa ake cin abu, saboda haka “ever” ya dace; dole ne ka duba ko yana nuna “sau nawa” ko “nawa”.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s2.model.1: Yawan haruffa ko lokaci ba ya bambance “ever” da “any”, don haka ma'aunin shi ne ko yana nuna yawan faruwa ko adadi.

l-e-h2-b06-07.title: Shin “could” ne ko “would” bayan “wish”?
l-e-h2-b06-07.goal: Zaɓi wane ma'auni (bayani) ake bukata da gaske don gano ko “could” ko “would” ya dace bayan “wish”, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h2-b06-07.material: Nemo bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske don yanke shawarar ko ‘could’ ko ‘would’ ya dace da guraben ‘I wish I ___ swim.’ da ‘I wish my phone ___ stop ringing.’
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.r.a: Matsayi ba shi da muhimmanci. Ma’aunin shi ne abin da kake son canzawa.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.o.b: Adadin kalmomin da subject na jimlar yake da su.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.r.b: Yawan kalmomi ba shi da muhimmanci.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.o.c: Adadin haruffan da ‘swim’ da ‘ring’ suke da su.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.o.d: Ko abin da kake son canzawa iyawarka ce ko aikin wani abu da ke maimaituwa.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.explain: Idan kana fatan kana da wata iyawa dabam, yi amfani da ‘could’ (‘I wish I could swim’); idan kana son aikin wani abu ya canza, yi amfani da ‘would’ (‘my phone would stop’).
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s2.model.0: Iyawar yin iyo taka ce, saboda haka ‘could’ ake amfani da shi; karar wayar kuwa aikin wani abu dabam ne, saboda haka ‘would’ ne. Ma’aunin shi ne abin da kake son canzawa.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s2.model.1: Adadin kalmomi ko haruffa ba ya bambance ‘could’ da ‘would’; saboda haka ma’aunin shi ne abin da kake son canzawa.

l-e-h2-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Idan Only + adverbial yana farkon jimla, kalmar taimako tana zuwa gaban mai aikatawa

l-e-h2-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: A dukkan jimlolin ukun Only da adverbial suna farko, kalmar taimako kuma tana gaban mai aikatawa; saboda haka ƙa'idar tana bayyana su duka.
l-e-h2-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Juyawar tsarin tana faruwa a can we da will you ma, waɗanda ba past tense ba ne; saboda haka ƙa'idar tana aiki idan Only + adverbial ya zo farko, ba tare da la'akari da tense ba.

l-e-h2-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Idan aka ƙara -en ga wide, strong, da short, suna zama fi'ilai masu ma'anar sa abu ya faɗi, ƙarfafa ko gajarta.
l-e-h2-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: A cikin kalmomin ukun, -en an haɗa shi da sifa ya samar da fi'ili mai ma'anar “sa ...”; saboda haka ƙa'idar daidai ce.
l-e-h2-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Sakamakon aiki ne, ba mutum ko ma'anar kishiya ba; saboda haka -en suffix ne da ke canza sifa zuwa fi'ili mai ma'anar “sa ...”.

l-e-h2-b03-11.title: Tsarin kalmomi idan furucin ‘no’ ya zo farko
l-e-h2-b03-11.goal: Daga misalai da dama na tsarin kalmomi idan furucin ‘no ~’ ya zo farko, gano ƙa’ida ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b03-11.material: ‘Under no circumstances should you open this door.’ / ‘At no time did the guard leave.’ / ‘In no way can this plan succeed.’ Gano ƙa’idar tsarin kalmomin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.o.a: Jimlolin da ke da ‘no’ kullum suna da inversion.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: Ana yin inversion ne kawai idan furucin ‘no’ ya zo farko. Ba a kula da matsayin furucin ba.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.o.b: Idan furucin ‘no’ ya zo farko, auxiliary verb yana zuwa gaban subject.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Ana amfani da ‘did’ da ‘can’ ma; saboda haka wannan bai dace da misalan ba.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: Ana amfani da ‘the guard’ da ‘this plan’ a matsayin subjects ma.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s1.explain: A cikin jimlolin ukun, furucin mai ‘no’ yana farko, kuma an yi inversion kamar ‘should you’, ‘did the guard’, ‘can this plan’.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: A cikin jimlolin ukun, furucin ‘no’ yana farko kuma auxiliary verb yana zuwa gaban subject; wannan ƙa’ida tana bayyana dukkansu.
l-e-h2-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Auxiliary verb da subject suna bambanta daga jimla zuwa jimla; saboda haka mabuɗin ƙa’idar shi ne matsayin furucin ‘no’ a farko, ba waɗannan ba.

l-e-h2-b03-12.title: Kalmomin nuna rashin tabbaci
l-e-h2-b03-12.goal: Daga misalai da dama na amfani da kalmomin nuna rashin tabbaci, gano ƙa’ida ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b03-12.material: Sales may have risen because of the sale. / The results suggest that sleep helps memory. / It is likely that the rain caused the delay. Gano ƙa’idar kalmomin da ke cikin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Idan ba a da tabbaci, ana amfani da kalmomi kamar ‘may’ da ‘suggest’.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Idan ba a san dalili ba, kullum a yi amfani da jimla musantacciya.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: Babu ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin ukun da yake musantacciya.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.o.c: Ana amfani da kalmomin nuna rashin tabbaci ne kawai idan akwai lambobi.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Babu lambobi a cikin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: Ana amfani da kalmomin nuna rashin tabbaci idan ƙarshe tabbatacce ne.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: Idan abin tabbatacce ne, ana amfani da kalmomi masu tabbatarwa.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s1.explain: ‘May’, ‘suggest’ da ‘likely’ kalmomi ne masu nuna rashin tabbaci. Yi amfani da su idan hujjojin ba su kai ga tabbatarwa ba.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Jimlolin ukun ba su tabbatar da dalilin kai tsaye ba, sun yi amfani da ‘may’, ‘suggest’ da ‘likely’; saboda haka kalmomi ne na nuna rashin tabbaci.
l-e-h2-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Saboda hujjojin ba su kai ga tabbatarwa ba, marubucin ya yi amfani da kalmomin nuna rashin tabbaci don guje wa tabbatacciyar magana; ƙa’idar ta dace da jimlolin ukun.

l-e-h2-b03-13.title: Siffar fi’ili bayan ‘would rather’
l-e-h2-b03-13.goal: Daga misalai da dama na siffar fi’ili bayan ‘would rather’ idan subject ya bambanta, gano ƙa’ida ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b03-13.material: ‘I’d rather you called first.’ / ‘I’d rather the guests arrived on time.’ / ‘I’d rather we walked.’ Gano ƙa’idar siffar fi’ilin a jimlolin ukun.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.o.a: Bayan ‘would rather’ kullum asalin fi’ili ne ke zuwa.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: ‘Called’, ‘arrived’ da ‘walked’ ba asalin siffofi ba ne.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.o.b: Bayan ‘would rather’ kullum -ing ne ke zuwa.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.r.b: Babu ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin ukun mai sigar -ing.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Idan subject dabam ya zo bayan ‘would rather’, ana amfani da sigar baya.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Babu ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin ukun da ke da ‘will’.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Idan subject dabam kamar ‘you’, ‘the guests’ ko ‘we’ ya zo bayan ‘I’d rather’, ana amfani da sigar baya kamar ‘called’, ‘arrived’ da ‘walked’.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Dukkan jimlolin ukun suna da subject dabam da fi’ilin sigar baya bayan ‘would rather’; saboda haka ƙa’idar daidai ce.
l-e-h2-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: ‘Called’, ‘arrived’ da ‘walked’ duk siffofin baya ne, amma ma’anarsu buri ne game da yanzu ko gaba; saboda haka za ka ga ƙa’idar sigar baya.

l-e-h2-b04-12.title: Bambanci tsakanin ‘would have’, ‘could have’ da ‘might have’
l-e-h2-b04-12.goal: Daga misalai da dama na auxiliary verb a result clause na zato game da baya, gano ƙa’ida ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b04-12.material: ‘If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.’ (tabbas da na kama shi) / ..., ‘I could have caught it.’ (da na iya kamawa) / ..., ‘I might have caught it.’ (watakila da na kama). Gano ƙa’idar.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.a: Auxiliary verbs ukun duk suna da ma’ana ɗaya.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Ma’anonin da ke cikin baka sun bambanta da juna.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.b: ‘Would’ yana nuna tabbas, ‘could’ yiwuwar iya yi, ‘might’ kuma rashin tabbaci.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.c: ‘Would’ ba shi da tabbaci, ‘might’ kuma yana nuna sakamako tabbatacce.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: ‘Would’ yana nuna tabbaci, ‘might’ kuma rashin tabbaci.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: ‘Could’ yana nuna yiwuwar faruwa, sakamako tabbatacce kuma ‘would’ ne.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.explain: A zato game da baya, ‘would have’ yana nuna sakamako tabbatacce, ‘could have’ yana nuna abin da zai yiwu, ‘might have’ kuma yana nuna sakamako marar tabbaci.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: ‘Would’ na nufin da tabbas na kama shi, ‘could’ na nufin da na iya kama shi, ‘might’ kuma watakila da na kama; saboda haka auxiliary verb yana nuna matakin tabbacin sakamako.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Ko da if clause ɗin ɗaya ce, ma’anonin da ke cikin baka sun bambanta; saboda haka auxiliary verb a result clause yana sauya matakin tabbacin.

l-e-h2-b05-11.title: Mene ne ƙa'idar tsarin kalmomi bayan “as did”?
l-e-h2-b05-11.goal: Dubi misalai da dama na tsarin kalmomi bayan “as”, mai ma'anar “haka ma”, nemo ƙa'idar, faɗi ta, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b05-11.material: Wages rose, as did prices. / Cats like fish, as do dogs. / The first test was hard, as was the second. Nemo ƙa'idar tsarin kalmomi bayan “as” a misalan nan.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.a: Idan aikatau yana zuwa gaban subject, yana nufin “haka ma”.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.b: Bayan “as”, kullum a yi amfani da “do”.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: “as was the second” yana amfani da “was”.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.c: Bayan “as”, subject ne ke zuwa farko.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: A cikin “as did prices”, aikatau “did” ne ke zuwa farko.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.d: Bayan “as” furuci mai saɓani da na baya ne ke zuwa.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Dukkan jimlolin ukun suna da ma'ana iri ɗaya da sashen da ya gabata.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Idan [auxiliary verb ko be-verb + subject] ya zo bayan “as”, kamar “did prices”, “do dogs”, da “was the second”, yana nufin “haka ma”.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: A duk misalan ukun, aikatau yana gaban subject bayan “as” kuma ma'anarsa “haka ma” ce, saboda haka wannan tsarin kalmomi shi ne ƙa'ida.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Did, do, da was suna canzawa bisa aikatau na jimlar baya, saboda haka bayan “as” a ɗauko aikatau na baya a yi inversion.

l-e-h2-b06-14.title: Yaushe za a iya barin relative pronoun?
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.prompt: Wace magana ce daidai bisa ƙa’idar da aka gano daga misalan?
l-e-h2-b06-14.goal: Daga misalai da dama na lokacin da za a iya cire relative pronoun, gano ƙa’ida ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h2-b06-14.material: ‘The film I saw was long.’ (daidai) / ‘The film that I saw was long.’ (daidai) / ‘The dog that barks is mine.’ (daidai) / ‘The dog barks is mine.’ (ba daidai ba) Gano ƙa’idar.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.a: Ana iya cire shi idan yana aikin object, ba idan yana aikin subject ba.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.b: Ana iya cire relative pronoun koyaushe.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.b: ‘The dog barks is mine’ jimla ce marar kyau.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya cire relative pronoun ko da yaushe ba.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.c: Wasu jimloli suna nan daidai idan an cire shi, kamar ‘The film I saw’.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.d: Ana iya cire shi idan yana aikin subject, ba idan yana aikin object ba.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.d: An cire ‘that’ da ke matsayin object na ‘I saw’.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.explain: A cikin ‘the film (that) I saw’, ‘that’ object ne na ‘saw’; saboda haka za a iya cire shi. A cikin ‘the dog that barks’, ‘that’ subject ne na ‘barks’; saboda haka ba za a iya cire shi ba.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s2.model.0: ‘That’ a jimlar fim ɗin object ne na ‘saw’; saboda haka an cire shi. ‘That’ a jimlar kare kuwa subject ne na ‘barks’; cire shi yana sa jimlar ba daidai ba. Ma’aunin shi ne aikinsa.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s2.model.1: Jimlar tana nan daidai idan an cire pronoun ɗin a matsayin object kawai; saboda haka dole ne a bar relative pronoun mai aikin subject.

l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.r.b: 7/12 ya fi rabi kuma ya fi 1/4 sosai.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.o.c: Gamsuwa ta ɗan haura rabi, saboda haka “most” ya yi daidai kaɗan-kaɗan.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Akwai korafe-korafe 5 da nazarce-nazarce 7 masu gamsuwa, don haka akasin haka ne.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.explain: 7/12 kusan 58% ne. Ya ɗan haura rabi, saboda haka most ya dace, amma ba kusan duka ba ne.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: 7/12 kusan 58% ne, ɗan sama da rabi, don haka za a iya kiyasin most ya dace kaɗan-kaɗan.

l-e-h2-b04-17.goal: Yi kiyasin kaso na rubutu da za ka iya karantawa cikin sauƙi don zaɓar girma ko zango, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h2-b04-17.material: Idan kalmomin da ba a sani ba sun kai 5% ko ƙasa da haka na rubutu, ana cewa karatun yana da sauƙi. Rubutu yana da kalmomi 30 da ban sani ba daga cikin kalmomi 400. Yi kiyasin ko za a iya karanta shi cikin sauƙi.

l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: 15% zai zama kalmomi 60. Kalmomi 30 kusan 7.5% ne.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.explain: 5% na kalmomi 400 kalmomi 20 ne, kuma 30 ya fi haka. Kusan 7.5% ne, saboda haka rubutu ne mai wahala.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: 5% na kalmomi 400 kalmomi 20 ne, 30 kuma ya fi haka, don haka yana da wahala a karanta cikin sauƙi.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Raba 30 da 400 yana ba da kusan 7.5%, wanda ya fi ma'aunin 5%, don haka rubutu ne mai wahala.

l-e-h2-b04-20.title: Kimanin clauses na -ever nawa ne a rubutun?

l-e-h2-b04-20.material: A cikin rubutu mai kalmomi 90, clause mai -ever kamar whenever ko whoever tana bayyana kusan sau ɗaya a kowace kalma 18. Yi kiyasin yawan clauses na -ever a rubutun.

l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.explain: 90 idan an raba da 18 shi ne 5. Idan guda ɗaya ne duk kalmomi 18, akwai kusan 5.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: Guda ɗaya na bayyana duk kalmomi 18, don haka 18 ya shiga 90 sau 5, wato kusan 5.

l-e-h2-b05-16.title: Minti nawa ake ɗauka don karanta rubutu mai kalmomi 600?
l-e-h2-b05-16.goal: Yi kiyasin lokacin karanta labari mai kalmomi 600, ka zaɓi girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h2-b05-16.material: Labari yana da kalmomi 600, kana karantawa da gudun kusan kalmomi 200 a minti 1. Yi kiyasin lokacin karanta shi gaba ɗaya.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Yaya tsawon lokacin karanta shi gaba ɗaya?
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Da kalmomi 200 a minti 1, kana karanta kusan kalmomi 100 cikin daƙiƙa 30.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.b: Wannan gudun kusan kalmomi 20 a minti 1 ne. Ya yi jinkiri sosai.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Wannan gudun kusan kalmomi 3 a minti 1 ne. Ya yi jinkiri sosai.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.explain: 600÷200=3. Idan kana karanta kalmomi 200 a minti 1, kusan minti 3 ake ɗauka.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: 600 idan an raba da 200 shi ne 3, don haka kusan minti 3 ake ɗauka.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Kalmomi 200 sau 3 suna yin kalmomi 600, saboda haka kusan minti 3 ne.

l-e-h2-b05-17.goal: Yi kiyasin adadin sababbin kalmomin da za a koya cikin shekara guda, zaɓi girma ko zangon da ya dace sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h2-b05-17.material: Kana koyon sababbin kalmomi 45 kowane wata, kana ci gaba na shekara 1 (watanni 12). Yi kiyasin adadin kalmomin da za ka koya gaba ɗaya.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.prompt: Kimanin nawa za su zama gaba ɗaya?
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.a: Wannan kusan ninki biyu na wata guda ne. Ba na watanni 12 ba ne.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.b: Wannan bai kai kusan rabin shekara ba ma.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.d: 45 a wata na watanni 12 ya yi ƙasa sosai da 5000.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.explain: Idan ka zagaye 45 zuwa 50, 50×12=600; idan ka zagaye zuwa 40, sai 480. Kusan 500 ya dace.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s2.model.0: Idan ka ɗauki 45 a matsayin tsakanin 40 da 50 ka ninka da 12, za ka samu tsakanin 480 da 600, don haka kusan 500 ne.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s2.model.1: Kana tara kalmomi 45 a wata sau 12, don haka kusan 500 ya dace.

l-e-h2-b05-18.title: Sau nawa inversion expression ke bayyana a makala?
l-e-h2-b05-18.goal: Yi kiyasin yawan inversion expressions a makala, zaɓi girma ko zangon da ya dace sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h2-b05-18.material: A cikin makala ta tsari, inversion da ta fara da adverb marar korewa tana bayyana kusan sau ɗaya a kowace kalma 250. Yi kiyasin sau nawa za ta bayyana a makala mai kalmomi 1000.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.prompt: Sau nawa za ta bayyana kusan?
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.a: Idan sau ɗaya ce ga kalmomi 250, a cikin kalmomi 1000 ta fi sau ɗaya.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.c: Sau 40 zai zama sau ɗaya ga kalmomi 25, ya yi yawa sosai.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.d: 250 tazarar kalmomi ce, ba yawan bayyanar ba.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.explain: 1000÷250=4. Idan tana bayyana sau ɗaya a kalmomi 250, tana bayyana kusan sau 4 a kalmomi 1000.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s2.model.0: 1000÷250=4, saboda haka tana bayyana kusan sau 4.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s2.model.1: Kalmomi 250 suna shiga cikin kalmomi 1000 sau 4, saboda haka kusan sau 4 ne.

l-e-h2-b05-19.material: Wani ya ce, “If the train were to arrive early, we would catch the 9:00 bus.” Yi kiyasin yadda mai maganar yake ganin yiwuwar jirgin ya iso da wuri.

l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: Idan kusan tabbatacce ne, za ka ce “If the train arrives early”.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Idan tabbatacce ne, ba za ka yi zato ba, za ka faɗi shi da “will”.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.explain: “If ... were to ...” zato ne na abin da ake ganin ba zai faru da wuya ba. Ya dace da abubuwan da ba kasafai suke faruwa ba, kamar 5%.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: “were to” yana zato cewa abu kusan ba zai faru ba, don haka ganin yiwuwarsa kusan 5% ya dace.

l-e-h2-b05-32.title: Wane furuci ne ke bayyana dalilin ɗaukar laima?
l-e-h2-b05-32.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi ko ikirari biyu na cewa a tanadi shiri don ruwan sama, zaɓi mafi dacewa sannan bayyana dalili.
l-e-h2-b05-32.material: Kana son cewa ya kamata wani ya yi shiri kafin a yi ruwa. A: Take an umbrella if it rains. B: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ya fi dacewa da ma'anar shiri tun da wuri?
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: A: “if” na nufin ɗaukar laima lokacin da aka yi ruwa
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: “if” sharaɗi ne cewa za ka yi hakan idan an yi ruwa. Ba shiri ne tun da wuri ba.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: B: “in case” na nufin ɗaukar ta tun da wuri domin wataƙila ruwan sama ya yi
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.c: Dukansu suna nufin shirya tun da wuri
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: “if” sharaɗi ne na bayan an yi ruwa.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: Babu ɗayansu da ya shafi shirya tun da wuri
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: “in case” na nufin kasancewa a shirye.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.explain: “in case ~” na nufin shirya tun da wuri domin “wataƙila ...”. “if ~” sharaɗi ne da za a aikata idan abin ya faru.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: “in case it rains” na nufin ɗaukar ta tun da wuri domin ruwan sama na iya yi; saboda haka B ta dace.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: “if it rains” sharaɗi ne na lokacin da ruwan sama ya yi; saboda haka bai dace da shirya tun da wuri ba.

l-e-h2-b06-31.title: ‘Were I’ ne ko ‘Was I’: wanne ne daidai?

l-e-h2-b06-31.material: Dalibai biyu sun rubuta ‘If I were you, I would wait.’ A: ‘Were I in your position, I would wait.’ B: ‘Was I in your position, I would wait.’

l-e-h2-b06-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Canza shi zuwa ‘was’ yayin yin inversion.

l-e-h2-b06-31.s.s1.r.c: Sigar inversion ta B ba daidai ba ce.
l-e-h2-b06-31.s.s1.explain: Idan aka cire ‘if’ daga ‘If I were in your position’ aka matsar da ‘were’ gaban subject, ana samun ‘Were I in your position’. ‘Were’ yana nan yadda yake.
l-e-h2-b06-31.s.s2.model.0: Idan ka cire ‘if’ ka matsar da ‘were’ gaban subject, ana samun ‘Were I’; saboda haka A daidai ce.
l-e-h2-b06-31.s.s2.model.1: B ta canza shi zuwa ‘was’, wanda ya bambanta da sigar inversion ta zato mai ‘were’; saboda haka ba daidai ba ce.

l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: Labarin ne ya nuna abu a fakaice; saboda haka A, mai amfani da ‘imply’, daidai ce.

l-e-h2-b06-34.material: Yanayin ya yi kyau, kana son furta mamaki a kansa. A: ‘What lovely weather!’ B: ‘How lovely weather!’
l-e-h2-b06-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Kafin suna ‘weather’, yi amfani da ‘What + adjective’.
l-e-h2-b06-34.s.s1.o.b: B: Kafin suna ‘weather’, yi amfani da ‘How + adjective’.
l-e-h2-b06-34.s.s1.r.b: Ba a saka suna kai tsaye bayan ‘How’. Rubuta kamar ‘How lovely the weather is!’
l-e-h2-b06-34.s.s1.r.c: B ba daidai ba ce domin suna yana zuwa kai tsaye bayan ‘How’.

l-e-h2-b06-35.material: Wani ya ji an shirya wani taro kuma ya ce yana huci, ‘Oh great, another meeting.’ A: Yana nuna farin ciki. B: Yana faɗin akasin abin da yake nufi domin nuna ɓacin rai.

l-e-h2-b01-38.material: Sharuɗɗa: ① Ba a kwanta da wuri ba jiya (gaskiyar baya) ② Ana jin gajiya yanzu (gaskiyar yanzu) ③ A ɗauka cewa akasin haka ne a jimla guda.

l-e-h2-b01-38.s.s1.r.b: Sakamakon yana cikin baya; saboda haka ba zai nuna sharadin cewa ba ka gaji yanzu ba.

l-e-h2-b01-38.s.s2.model.0: Ta yi amfani da past perfect a if-clause da ‘would + base verb’ a result clause don nuna dalilin baya da sakamakon yanzu; saboda haka ta dace.
